Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

About HubSpot
HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.
At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.
We’re building a company where people can do their best work . We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.
Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Sales Consultant – Recruiting & Neukundengewinnung (m/w/d)
Du bist im Vertrieb zuhause – und merkst langsam, dass dir etwas fehlt. Vielleicht eine Provision, die nicht bei einem festgelegten Wert endet. Vielleicht ein Produkt, hinter dem du wirklich stehst. Oder einfach der Punkt, an dem der Kunde nach der Unterschrift an jemand anderen übergeben wird und du nie erfährst, ob dein Versprechen gehalten hat.
Bei uns läuft das anders: Du gewinnst den Kunden
und lieferst danach selbst ab. Du berätst Unternehmen zu ihren Recruiting-Problemen, verkaufst die Lösung – und setzt sie anschließend eigenverantwortlich um. Ein Ansprechpartner, ein Verantwortlicher, ein Ergebnis.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Arbeitgebermarke sichtbar zu machen und planbar qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting statt Bauchgefühl. Der Markt dafür wächst jedes Jahr weiter, weil Fachkräftemangel und demografischer Wandel nicht kleiner werden.
Was für dich drin ist
Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter Bonus – kein Deckel, keine gestaffelten Bremsen. Was du holst, bekommst du.
Unbefristete Festanstellung – wir bauen langfristig auf dich, in einer Branche, die stabil wächst.
Zweites Standbein: Recruiting-Know-how – du lernst nicht nur zu verkaufen, sondern auch zu liefern. Das Doppelprofil aus Vertrieb und Recruiting ist im Markt aktuell das gefragteste überhaupt. Entwicklungspfad: Sales Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & echtes Coaching – Schulungen in Beratung, Vertrieb und Recruiting, dazu regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions statt einmaliger Einarbeitung.
Arbeitsplatz ohne Kompromisse – höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac), Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Premium-Fitnessvertrag im Studio deiner Wahl.
Versorgung im Office – Faema-E61-Siebträger mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, gute Tees und flexibles Lunch-System über Meyer Menü.
Kurze Wege – direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kollegiale und leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einer Schublade.
Dein Tag bei uns
Du gewinnst die Projekte
Du sprichst potenzielle Neukunden aktiv an – telefonisch, per Video-Call und über Direktansprache – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst, woran das Recruiting im jeweiligen Unternehmen hakt, benennst den konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst daraus eine passende Strategie.
Du präsentierst deine Lösung und führst den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.
Du setzt sie um
Nach der Unterschrift steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur besetzten Stelle.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst die Vorqualifizierung und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten einen professionellen Eindruck von deinem Kunden bekommen.
Dein Fundament
Du pflegst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielgerichtet auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Prozessverbesserung ein.
Das solltest du mitbringen
Vertriebserfahrung – ob Telefonvertrieb, Außendienst, Einzelhandel, Fitness- oder Versicherungsbranche: Wenn du weißt, wie sich ein "Nein" anfühlt und wie man trotzdem weitermacht, passt das.
Beratungsverständnis – du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst Lösungen strukturiert rüber.
Menschenkenntnis – du verstehst die Perspektive des Unternehmens genauso wie die des Bewerbers.
Eigeninitiative und Leistungswille – du arbeitest selbstständig und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse, nicht durchschnittliche.
Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei. Uns interessiert weniger dein Lebenslauf als das, was du daraus machen willst.
So geht es weiter
Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, dein Lebenslauf reicht.
Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.
Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team. Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.

Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.

Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.

Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.

Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.

Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.

Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.

Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.

Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.

Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.

Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.

Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.

Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.

Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.

Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.

Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.

Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.

Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.

Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.

Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.

Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.

Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.

Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.
We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers on the front line of inspection. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We have grown revenue 1 0x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026 . Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX .
We’ve assembled a best-in-class team : people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.
We are looking for an ENT Sales Executive who is entrepreneurial and a commercial powerhouse ready to lead our revenue growth from the front lines.
You’ve already proven you can sell somewhere else and you’ve hit or beaten quota, and you know how to run a deal end to end. Now you want more than the next quota. You want to build the system, not just work inside one someone else built. This is a role for someone who wants to take the next step in their career who’s hungry to own pre-sales and post-sales, not just the close.
If you’re energised by high velocity, deep customer relationships, and the chance to build something from nothing in a massive legacy market, this will be a career-defining role.

Own the full sales lifecycle : Manage the entire funnel from initial discovery and platform deep-dives to commercial negotiation and closing five- and six-figure ARR deals.
Build what happens after the deal closes : Set up onboarding and customer success frameworks from scratch, so early customers get value fast and become references for the next deal.
Master the TIC domain : Become an absolute expert on our product and the workflows of our customers (lab managers, compliance directors, and operations executives). You won’t rely on a carousel of sales engineers, you will be the trusted advisor.
Navigate high stakes £100k+ ARR cycles : Lead complex, multi-month enterprise sales cycles with global TIC organisations, confidently navigating multi stakeholder buying committees, rigorous governance/security reviews, and legal bottlenecks to close seven figure, transformational deals.
Shape the GTM playbook : Work closely with our Founders, Product, and Marketing teams to test new messaging, refine our outbound strategies, and relay direct market feedback to help steer the product roadmap.
Wear multiple hats : In an early-stage startup, "that's not my job" doesn't exist. You’ll occasionally step up to support onboarding, attend industry events, or jump into whatever the week needs.

We don’t care about a perfect, check-box resume. We care about hunger, sales instinct, and the drive to build something that doesn’t exist yet. You’ll be a fantastic fit if:
You’ve already proven you can sell: 3–6 years of experience in a fast-paced B2B software sales or comparable commercial role (e.g. enterprise SaaS, top-tier consulting, or tech-forward industrial sales), with a track record of beating quota.
You’ve outgrown your current setup: You’ve hit a ceiling and there is too much structure, not enough ownership, a playbook you didn’t write and can’t change and you’re ready to build one from scratch instead.
You love the weeds and the big picture: You can zoom in to understand a granular, technical workflow for a testing lab, and zoom out to negotiate a strategic contract with an executive.
You are comfortable with ambiguity: We have product-market fit, but we are still building the machine. You don't need a fully-baked playbook; you are excited to build it as you go.

## Das erwartet dich ##
Bei der Mobiliar Generalagentur Wil legen wir Wert auf nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Servicequalität. Im Verkaufssupport leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur zielgerichteten Unterstützung unseres Beraterteams und zur professionellen Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.

Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberaterinnen und -berater im Tagesgeschäft unterstützt und aktiv zur verlässlichen Betreuung unserer Kundschaft beiträgt.

Mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise und deinem Dienstleistungsverständnis stärkst du das Vertrauen in die Mobiliar als persönlichste Versicherung der Schweiz.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungsberaterinnen und -berater im operativen Alltag und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich administrative und koordinierende Aufgaben.
Dazu gehören die Erstellung von Korrespondenz, Auswertungen sowie die Bearbeitung von Offerten, Anträgen und Vertragsunterlagen. Im direkten Kundenkontakt am Telefon oder am Schalter betreust du unsere Kundschaft kompetent und verlässlich.
Du beantwortest Anfrage und koordinierst Termine über sämtliche Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Als Teil des Verkaufssupportteams arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung innerhalb der Versicherungsbranche
* Ausbildung Versicherungsvermittler oder Versicherungsvermittlerin VBV oder Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
* Interesse an einem vielseitigen Tätigkeitsfeld und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
* Strukturierte, selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Teamorientierung, hohe Hilfsbereitschaft und professionelle Grundhaltung
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
Auf der Generalagentur Wil erwartet dich ein engagiertes und vielfältiges Team. Gemeinsam stärken wir unsere regionale Verankerung und schaffen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden konsistente 5 Sterne Erlebnisse. Wir pflegen einen offenen, respektvollen und kollegialen Austausch und arbeiten lösungsorientiert sowie verantwortungsbewusst zusammen. Dich erwarten klare Strukturen, kurze Entscheidungswege, eine sorgfältige Einführung sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen bei der Mobiliar.
Dein Arbeitsort ist auf unserer Hauptagentur in Ebnat-Kappel und der Stellenantritt erfolgt nach Vereinbarung.
Das Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz verlangt zur Ausübung dieser Funktion den Abschluss Versicherungsvermittler/-in VBV, Profil Allbranche. Sollte dieser nicht vorhanden sein, unterstützen wir gerne mit massgeschneiderten internen Ausbildungen.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is growing its channel sales team to capitalize on rapidly growing demand from channel partners, leveraging their expertise and connections to bring open source technology to organizations across a multitude of industries.
The Channel Partner Sales Executive, Japan role reports to the Director, APAC Channel Sales and requires a mix of both farming and hunting capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned annual growth quotas.
They should be able to identify, prospect, and engage reseller and distributor partners to build and maintain relationships and grow Canonical’s business within the assigned territory.
The successful candidate must be comfortable owning and leading initiatives in an unstructured, startup-like environment. This individual must be able to sell open source, cloud, virtualization, and technical software solutions.
Although the role is focused primarily on reseller and distributor channel partners, the successful candidate must be capable of and comfortable with initial customer discovery calls and presentations as appropriate.
Location: Japan

Develop and execute channel strategy for distributors and resellers within the assigned territory
Increase awareness of Canonical as a lead player in Open Source and Cloud (Private, Hybrid, Multi, and Public models)
Identify and recruit new potential partners in assigned territory
Leverage personal network and prospecting skills to engage new partners and build on Canonical’s already-successful relationships
Guide partners through onboarding and enablement
Develop mutually beneficial go-to-market plans and commitments with partners
Arrange and execute sales and pre sales trainings to these resellers
Drive and manage channel pipeline through recurring partner interactions
Support partner’s satisfaction and act as trusted advisor and point of contact
Maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with priority resellers and distributors.

About ISSA : ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more!

For over 35 years, ISSA has created a personal fitness training program to merge gym experience with practical and applied sciences. With over 250 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries.

We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!
We are adding an Inside Sales Representative (Fitness Education Advisor) to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into every day!
So What's the Job?
We’re looking for competitive, coachable, and high-energy Inside Sales Representatives who thrive in a fast-paced, phone-first environment. You’ll engage with prospective students, uncover their goals, and guide them to the right ISSA program, all while driving toward individual and team performance goals.
At ISSA , you’re not just selling, you’re helping people transform their lives through education. We believe in doing the right thing, growing together, and celebrating the wins that matter.

Make 120–200 outbound calls daily to prospective students from warm and cold lists.
Conduct high-energy phone consultations to identify goals, build rapport, and recommend training programs.
Manage your pipeline through a CRM with disciplined notes, tasks, and follow-ups.
Close sales in a short cycle (same-day to 7 days) using ethical persuasion and student-first judgment.
Consistently meet or exceed monthly enrollment and revenue targets.
Collaborate with peers and leaders to improve scripts, objection handling, and conversion rates.
Represent ISSA ’s mission and brand with integrity and enthusiasm.

1+ years of phone-based inside sales experience in a quota-driven environment.
Demonstrated ability to sustain high activity levels (120–200+ dials per day).
Experience in short-cycle or one-call closes (same day to 7 days).
Comfort working shift-based schedules in a fully remote setup.
Strong verbal communication, active listening, and empathy.
Track record of hitting or exceeding individual sales targets.
Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
Continuously identifies opportunities to leverage AI tools for efficiency and innovation.

Experience in B2C or consumer-style B2B sales environments.
Prior success with outbound sales or lead follow-up campaigns.
High energy and resilience in competitive, metrics-driven settings.

s.h: Interest in the fitness, health, or education industries.
s.t:
Prior ISSA certification or wellness industry exposure.
Advanced CRM hygiene and data management habits.

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA , we're looking for the same kind of person.
Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.
We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.
We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

About Airwallex
Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
Attributes We Value
We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

As a Founding SDR (Germany) , you will serve as the growth engine for Airwallex’s expansion in the DACH region. This is a zero-to-one builder role: you will not just execute outbound sequences, you will design the playbooks, test AI-assisted outreach tools, define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and establish the foundation for our German pipeline.
Operating with an entrepreneurial mindset, you will bridge the gap between marketing initiatives and closed deals, driving high-value opportunities into the funnel. For top performers, this role offers a clear trajectory into a Closing Business Development Manager (BDM)/Account Executive role.

Build and Scale German Outbound: Design, iterate, and execute a modern, AI-assisted outbound strategy (sequencing, enrichment, lead scoring) tailored specifically to the German market.
Generate and Qualify Pipeline: Identify high-value accounts, initiate contact via multi-channel plays (cold calls, personalized email, social selling), and qualify interest to generate high-volume, high-quality sales pipeline.
Create Playbooks and Assets: Develop and test target prospect plays across the buyer journey, creating the scalable tools, messaging frameworks, and assets needed for market expansion.
Product-Led Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing and Product teams to launch bespoke, localized campaigns and turn market feedback into actionable insights.
Seamless Sales Hand-Offs: Move qualified prospects smoothly through the early funnel, uncovering deep business needs before briefing sales leadership for closed-loop hand-offs.
CRM and Data Hygiene: Maintain meticulous CRM records, monitor activity SLAs, and analyze outbound performance metrics to continuously optimize response and conversion rates.

Proven SDR Track Record: 1+ years of experience in a high-performing B2B SaaS or Fintech SDR/BDR role with a history of exceeding targets.
Zero-to-One Mindset: Demonstrated experience setting up or refining outbound strategies (ICP definitions, playbooks, toolstacks) in a new or early-stage market.
Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in German (verbal and written) and professional working fluency in English .
AI and Modern Sales Tech Stack: Hands-on experience leveraging modern outbound AI tools (such as automated enrichment, AI co-pilots, intent data, hyper-personalized messaging).
Bias for Action: Thrives in ambiguity, acts with high urgency, and brings a hyper-growth, team-first attitude.
